chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar quoted Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mughira al-Kufi, on the authority of Al-Abbas ibn Amer al-Qasbani, on the authority of Rabi'a ibn Muhammad al-Muslemi, on the authority of Al-Hasan ibn Sowir ibn Abi Fakhte, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn al-Hussein (peace be upon them both) who said:

When our Riser (peace be upon him) rises, the Honorable the Exalted God will remove any weakness/defect from our Shiites, and make their hearts like the back of iron, and make the strength of each man among them equal to the strength of forty men, and they will become the rulers of the Earth and its peak.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics and strengths of the Shiites when the Mahdi rises?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS), highlighting the divine empowerment of the faithful during the era of the Mahdi. The text emphasizes a transformation from spiritual and physical vulnerability to invincibility, where believers are granted the strength of forty men and become the 'preeminent leaders' (sumam) of the Earth, fulfilling the prophetic promise of divine inheritance.
